descriptions.A: A young adult woman in her twenties with a low contralto voice. Dry, calm, warm, and quietly wry, like a rakugo storyteller or a patient narrator reading a fable aloud by lamplight. Close-mic, intimate, unhurried, clear consonants, completely natural and grounded. Neutral, lightly British-leaning accent.
descriptions.B: A calm young woman with a low, warm alto voice who narrates stories. Deadpan and dry with a hint of fondness; she speaks slowly and precisely, never theatrical, never breathy. Natural conversational delivery, recorded close and dry in a quiet room. Neutral accent.
descriptions.C: A composed young adult woman, low mezzo voice, the understated narrator of a folk tale. Precise diction, gentle dry humour, grounded and steady, a little smoky, very natural and human. Close, intimate microphone. Neutral North American accent.
